title: Placed Right Where You Are
story: For Such a Time as This
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Proud Haman made a wicked plan
To hurt God's people dear.
Then Mordecai sent Esther word:
"Please help; the king must hear!"

[Chorus]
For such a time as this, my child,
God placed you where you are.
He has a purpose just for you
Right here, not somewhere far.

[Verse 2]
But Esther was afraid to go,
She felt so scared and small.
Then Mordecai said, "Maybe God
Made you queen for us all!"

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Now close your eyes, and think of this:
You have a purpose, too.
The Lord who made brave Esther queen
Has good things planned for you.

[Chorus]
mood: Wondering music. A soft, floating pulse drifts under the voice, still and thoughtful, like Esther growing quiet as she thinks about why she is here. The chorus rises gently, as if a light comes on inside. By the last verse the drift slows and sinks lower, the wondering turns to trust, and the song settles into a hush with God close by.
